entities.name: Sandruu
entities.description: Anaba minotaur and planeswalker from Ulgrotha, friend of Feroz, banished by Taysir and recruited by Ravidel for the Planeswalkers' War.

entities.name: Feroz
entities.description: Good friend of Sandruu who helped him ascend.

entities.name: Kristina of the Woods
entities.description: Planeswalker with whom Sandruu fell in love.

entities.name: Taysir
entities.description: Kristina's former lover who banished Sandruu.

entities.name: Ravidel
entities.description: Planeswalker whose Mox Beacon called Sandruu to Dominaria and who recruited him with misleading images.

entities.name: Jared Carthalion
entities.description: Man shown in out-of-context images with Kristina.

entities.name: Planeswalkers' War
entities.description: War on Dominaria to which Sandruu was called.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Plane where the Planeswalkers' War occurred.

entities.name: Mox Beacon
entities.description: Ravidel's device that called Sandruu to Dominaria.

events.summary: Sandruu falls in love with Kristina of the Woods while exploring the multiverse.
events.quote: Sandruu fell in love with Kristina of the Woods

events.summary: Taysir hunts Sandruu down and banishes him to a plane from which return would take a millennium.
events.quote: banished him to a plane from which it would take a millennium to return

events.summary: Seven decades later Ravidel's Mox Beacon calls Sandruu to Dominaria to fight in the Planeswalkers' War.
events.quote: Sandruu was called to Dominaria by Ravidel 's Mox Beacon

events.summary: Ravidel recruits Sandruu by showing him out-of-context images of Kristina in bed with Jared Carthalion.
events.quote: Ravidel recruited Sandruu to his cause by showing him out-of-context images

relations.note: He fell in love with her.
relations.quote: Sandruu fell in love with Kristina of the Woods

relations.note: Taysir was enraged and banished him.
